name: WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator
author: THE BELOV

sections.description:
For health, parenting & family planning websites: the most complete pregnancy and ovulation calculator plugin for WordPress!

WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator by Belov is a plugin and a marketing tool that helps you engage visitors on health and family planning websites.

This plugin turns your WordPress site into a helpful resource for expectant parents and couples planning a family. Whether you run a parenting blog, a women’s health clinic website, or a fertility support platform, the WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator will keep your visitors coming back.

Having a pregnancy or ovulation calculator on your website is an absolute must if your business is in the maternal health, parenting, or family planning space. Your visitors will love the opportunity to track due dates, pregnancy milestones, and fertile windows right on your site. Make your service stand out and get more leads!

FIVE PREGNANCY CALCULATION METHODS

No two pregnancies are the same, and neither should your calculator be. WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator offers five distinct methods to ensure every visitor gets the most accurate results:

  • Due Date Calculator — Estimate the due date based on the last menstrual period
  • Last Period Calculator — Calculate the last period date from an estimated due date
  • Conception Date Calculator — Find out the conception date and other key pregnancy milestones
  • Ultrasound Due Date Calculator — Determine due dates using ultrasound measurements
  • IVF Pregnancy Calculator — Special calculations for pregnancies conceived via IVF

OVULATION & FERTILITY TRACKING

Help your visitors plan ahead with precise ovulation and fertility window calculations. The ovulation calendar displays fertile days, ovulation dates, and the best times to conceive — all based on scientifically recognized cycle-length formulas.

SCIENCE BEHIND THE CALCULATIONS

Pregnancy tracking involves many variables — last menstrual period, cycle length, ultrasound data, and more. Doing those calculations manually is impractical and error-prone.

Our calculator uses Naegele’s rule and other standard obstetric formulas trusted by healthcare professionals worldwide. The results include estimated due dates, trimester breakdowns, and week-by-week pregnancy milestones — giving your visitors a comprehensive view of their pregnancy journey.

HOW IT WORKS

WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator gives you a shortcode to place on any page, post, or widget. Put it where it catches the most attention!

Dates, methods, milestones: the calculator covers everything

Once installed, you get an intuitive settings panel in your WordPress admin area. Configure the calculation method, date formats, result display, and styling — all in one place. Generate your shortcode and paste it anywhere on your site.

Flexible date formats

The plugin supports multiple date formats (MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, and more) to suit your audience worldwide. No confusion, no manual conversion needed.

Increasing screentime

A pregnancy calculator is one of the most engaging features you can offer. Expectant parents can’t resist checking their due dates, tracking week-by-week progress, and exploring fertility windows. Keep them on your site longer!

Handy & user-friendly

The calculator displays results instantly after submission — clear, visual, and beautifully formatted. Week-by-week pregnancy timelines, trimester highlights, and ovulation calendars are presented in an intuitive layout that visitors love.

BOOST YOUR HEALTH & PARENTING WEBSITE

Running a WordPress site for expectant parents, fertility clinics, or wellness professionals? WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator by Belov is the easiest way to capture attention and personalize the experience.

Interactive tools hold attention like nothing else! Your site visitors will spend more time engaging with the calculator and will be much more likely to convert into clients or subscribers.

Personalize user experience for your visitors and grow your health & parenting platform!

Read more on the WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator website.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Styling

The plugin lets you change interface colors to match your website’s design. Use the built-in color picker to adjust the primary and secondary colors. The Pro version provides even more flexibility with advanced color schemes, custom layouts, and complete design control.

Responsive on all devices

The calculator is fully optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop. Your visitors get a seamless experience regardless of their device — no pinching, zooming, or horizontal scrolling.

PRO EDITION

Advanced features, email marketing integrations, and a powerful admin dashboard: make the most of WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator!

Unlimited calculators

Create as many calculator instances as you need — different pages, different settings, different styles. Perfect for multi-topic health websites.

PDF results & email templates

Let your visitors download their pregnancy results as a beautifully formatted PDF or receive them via email. Customize the templates with your branding, logo, and message.

Optimize your marketing

The Pro version has excellent integrations with popular marketing services:

  • Mailchimp
    Collect emails, build your subscriber list, and run targeted campaigns.

  • HubSpot
    Sync contacts and nurture leads with automated marketing workflows.

  • Kit (ConvertKit)
    Grow your email list with seamless creator-focused integration.

  • Zapier & Make
    Connect to 5,000+ apps and automate your business processes.

More integrations are coming soon!

Other Pro features

Improve user experience with a fully enhanced toolkit:

  • Custom labels & translations for every field
  • Advanced color schemes and layouts
  • Google reCAPTCHA integration
  • CSV export for data analysis
  • Entries management dashboard
  • Priority support

And much more to elevate your website.

WHO IS THIS PLUGIN FOR?

  • Health & Wellness Websites — Provide valuable pregnancy and ovulation tracking tools
  • Parenting Blogs — Enhance your content with interactive family planning features
  • Fertility Clinics & OB/GYN Sites — Offer patients accurate due date and ovulation estimates
  • Family Planning Platforms — Support users on their journey to parenthood
  • Doulas & Midwives — Give clients a handy tool right on your website

Try WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator today and give your visitors a truly helpful family planning tool!

TRANSLATIONS

  • English: default, always included.

Note: The plugin is localized/translateable by default. For translating we recommend the awesome plugin Loco Translate.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen, or upload the files to /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-pregnancy-ovulation-calculator.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Pregnancy & Ovulation in your wp-admin menu and configure the calculator settings.
  4. Copy the shortcode and place it on any page, post, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I add the calculator to my page?

Go to Pregnancy & Ovulation in your admin menu, configure your settings, then copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget.

Can I customize the colors of the calculator?

Yes! Use the built-in color picker in the plugin settings to match your website’s design. The Pro version offers even more styling options.

Which pregnancy calculation methods are available?

The plugin supports five methods: Due Date (LMP), Last Period, Conception Date, Ultrasound, and IVF. Configure the method in Settings.

Can I display both pregnancy and ovulation calculators?

Currently, one calculator type is displayed per shortcode instance. Select the type in the plugin settings.

How accurate are the calculations?

The calculator uses Naegele’s rule and standard obstetric formulas trusted by healthcare professionals. These are estimates — for medical advice, always consult a healthcare provider.

Can I change the date format?

Yes, select your preferred date format (MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, etc.) in the plugin settings.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The calculator is fully responsive and optimized for all screen sizes.

How do I get support?

You can ask your question on the WordPress support forum or contact us through our website.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0 2026-02-25

  • Renamed plugin to WP Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator.
  • Redesigned admin settings UI with modern styles.
  • Added PRO feature previews (Integrations, Labels, Email/PDF tabs).
  • Added sidebar banners for PRO upgrade and reviews.
  • Added “Get PRO” and “Settings” action links in the plugin list.
  • Added “Download PRO” submenu link in admin menu.
  • Removed unused legacy files.

1.1.6

  • Fixed an off-by-one day issue in date calculations.

1.1.5

  • Updated gulp POT generation to use active text domain so translations populate correctly.

1.1.4

  • Optimized frontend assets for improved performance.

1.1.3

  • Fixed baby-born template display issue when due date is in full weeks.

1.1.2

  • Changed text label from ‘days until meeting’ to ‘days until birth’ for better clarity.
  • Resolved a style conflict with third-party themes that caused the color of the strong tag to display incorrectly.

1.1.1

  • Resolved a style conflict with third-party plugins that caused the datepicker calendar to display incorrectly.

1.1.0

  • Resolved an issue where pregnancy term calculations could change mid-day due to timezone differences. Date calculations are now consistently based on midnight for more accurate and stable results.
  • Tested for compatibility with WordPress 6.8.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the Ultimate Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator.
  • Includes two calculation modes: Pregnancy Calculator and Ovulation Calculator.
  • Customizable design and responsive layout.
  • Easy integration with shortcode.
